computer science.description: Offering undergraduate and graduate degrees in computer science and data science.

software engineering.description: Providing focus on software architecture, design, and software engineering methodologies.

mechanical engineering.description: Studies in solid mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics, and manufacturing.

business administration.description: Undergraduate programs in finance, marketing, management, and business analytics.

finance.description: Responsible for student billings, fee structures, and semester payments.

student affairs.description: Manages campus clubs, events, and student welfare services.

it helpdesk.description: Assists with portal logins, wifi access, and email credentials.

admin office.description: Handles overall university administration and campus policies.

merit scholarship.requirements: Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5 each semester

need scholarship.coverage: Varying assistance from 20% to 80% tuition waiver
need scholarship.requirements: Household annual income documentation and interview

sports scholarship.requirements: Active participation in university varsity team and GPA of 2.5+

counseling.description: Providing confidential personal and academic mental health support.

career helpdesk.description: Assisting with resume reviews, internship placements, and mock interview preparations.

central library.description: Access to 50,000+ reference books, study areas, and online academic databases.

health center.description: Provides first aid, general checkups, and emergency medical assistance.

student support office.description: General assistance for student life, housing, and general inquiries.

registration_details.course add/drop: The course add/drop period strictly ends on the second Friday of the semester.
registration_details.registration deadline: The standard registration deadline is one week before the semester starts. Late registration incurs a penalty.

schedule_details.class timetable: Class timetables are finalized and published on the student portal two weeks before the semester starts.
schedule_details.semester start/end: The Fall semester starts in September and ends in December. The Spring semester starts in January and ends in May.
